description: Introspect the active key (GET /v1/me): org, environment (test/live), granted scopes, and rate-limit/credit posture. Organization and project IDs appear in text and structuredContent. Use verbose=true for key identity details. Use it before usage and to diagnose a 401/403/402.

verbose.description: Include authorized identity details in text. Credentials are always omitted.
